estimand: Discrimination of a treatment-switch-defined proxy for incident treatment-resistant depression, assigned within one year of the index antidepressant prescription, on a held-out stratified 20% split of 42579 adults with unipolar major depressive disorder, measured by area under the ROC curve.
reader: Clinical informatics and psychiatry researchers. They know what an ROC curve is and do not need it defined. They do not know what a sentence-transformer encoder is and will not accept one described only by its name.

conventions.tense: past for what was done and found, present for what is true
conventions.interval: 95% CI written as (95% CI 0.643-0.672), en dash between bounds
conventions.auc: ROC AUC, three decimal places in prose, four in tables
conventions.second_reference: a model is named once in full then by its classifier

out_of_scope: any claim of clinical utility or deployment readiness
any claim that the outcome label is equitable across groups
any claim about causal effect of treatment
any claim of external or temporal validity

terminology.definition: The typed feature vector built directly from coded EHR fields. "feature vector" and "typed feature vector" are APPROVED second names, declared in the manuscript's naming block. "feature matrix" is NOT: it was the undeclared third name, eleven uses across the packet, removed 2026-09-07.

The deterministic Markdown narrative encoded by a pretrained sentence-transformer. "embedded model" and "embedded arm" are APPROVED second names: one is the classifier fitted on this representation, the other is the study arm.

The OUTCOME LABEL, a treatment-switch proxy. Distinct from 'treatment resistance', which is the underlying construct the label stands in for. The paper turns on that distinction, so the construct's name is not a forbidden alias. The label is described as a PRESCRIPTION SEQUENCE or a treatment-switch proxy and by no other name; four competing names for it were in one Introduction before 2026-09-06.
The earliest antidepressant prescription on or after the first documented depression diagnosis.
Area under the receiver operating characteristic curve.
